traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Limnanthaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple or compound; compound leaves pinnate; veins pinnate; stipules absent; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior or half inferior; floral cup present; stems herbaceous; flowers solitary; flowers actinomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; fruit schizocarp; parts of each whorl 3 to 5; stamens 3 to 10; carpels 2 to 5. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.

traits.flowering_position.note: APweb, Brassicales page, Limnanthaceae (read 2026-10-16): single axillary flowers.
